d: Donald Trump called it 'Epic Fury.' Voters called it a mistake. On November 4, exit polls showed 74% of Americans said the Iran war was a crucial factor in their vote — and 62% said it was wrong. Gas hit $4.12 a gallon. Democrats flipped both the House and Senate. Ohio, Iowa, Kansas, North Carolina — red states fell one by one. Muhammad El-Sayed won Michigan, becoming the first Muslim US Senator in American history. Republican candidates who distanced themselves from Trump's war lost anyway. Did the Iran war cost Trump Congress? The verdict is in. Cary Johnston brings you the details on…
